notes: Shared by engine/test/seance/classification-vectors.test.ts and the generated Classifier.sol forge test (vm.parseJson / stdJson). legacy and port use the in-process CallRecord shape: success (boolean), data (0x hex), logs ([{emitter, topics, data}], emitter is 'SELF' or an address), state (object name -> 0x hex value, as in the TS CallRecord). Solidity consumers must enumerate state keys with vm.parseJsonKeys and read each value by its key; keys such as 'allowed(0xA1,0xA2)' contain parentheses and commas, so use the key returned by parseJsonKeys, not a hand-built JSONPath. A null legacy/port, a missing field, or a wrongly typed field stands for a malformed record; Solidity consumers should treat a vector whose record fails to decode as malformed (invalidRecord true, empty differingFields). expect.classification is one of match, reason-modernised, exorcised, port-bug; expect.differingFields is sorted (UTF-16 order) and unique.
